mechanism: Only reorder cached jobs when original scheduler chose a cached job; minimize full optical traversal plus transit to nearest unvisited station. Keep scan/uncached/forced decisions.
development: 52 existing cases x both rounding models; reused round5 structured and ordinary/outer fixtures are development if inspected, never fresh validation.
selection: Require complete/audited; development mean lower without higher P95 in both rounding models. If passed, lock before new ordinary/outer fixtures; require same criteria in each fresh validation batch. Do not retune on fresh cases.
prohibited: No official exe/rehearsal/formal execution. Do not claim global route optimality.
